events.title: Next Fest Demo Update and a Note from the Team
events.summary: Hello, this is Obliqon, the team behind Net Raiders.First, we owe you an apology. We've been so focused on development that we neglected to keep you informed and to talk with you. The demo has been updated many times, but because we never shared what changed, it may have looked as if the game had stood still. events.title: To All Raiders: Core System Update & Patch Notes
events.summary: Hello, Raiders. This is Obliqon Games.First, we would like to sincerely apologize for the lack of frequent communication. Despite the great interest you’ve shown in our game, our small team size has made it challenging to stay as connected with our community as we would have liked.
